title: Finding kinds: fix, owner or later in reviewer, UI pass and gate reports

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R4 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). Design calls went into fix rounds (S65 spent grant) or into later notes only the outer session read (S84 UI suggestions). adj 163 (review.finding-kinds, open; recommended fix-owner-later).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md`, `internal/roles/prompts/gate.md`: each finding carries a kind.
- `internal/engine/report.go`: parse kinds; owner findings become structured questions (S111); later findings become offers to file a slice.
- `internal/engine/states.go:229-291`: only fix findings go to the fix round.
- `internal/tui/pane.go`: later findings offered as "file as slice" (one key).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestFindingKindsRouted: fix goes to the fix round, owner to a question, later to an offer.
- TestOwnerFindingBlocksOnlyWhenMarked.
- TestLaterFindingFiledOnConfirm: confirm runs slicer add with --discovered-from.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Wait for adj 163 and S111. A report without kinds is treated as all fix (back-compatible).

adj 163 is decided (fix-owner-later); S111 has landed. Owner decision (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): on confirm of a later finding, ork itself runs slicer add TITLE --discovered-from ID in the project, with a Why section from the finding; slicer stays the owner of the record. Say so in docs/boundaries.md.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
